title: Microsoft Purview — DLP, Sensitivity Labels & Retention (Government / GCC High)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Government edition — GCC High tenant).

GOVERNMENT/GCC HIGH EDITION: authored for US sovereign cloud. Use compliance.microsoft.us / security.microsoft.us / portal.office365.us / login.microsoftonline.us; call out feature parity gaps vs Commercial (some Purview features are delayed/limited/absent in GCC High). Never invent GCC High specifics — cite Microsoft US Gov docs; where uncertain, state the Commercial path and flag 'verify for GCC High'.
hook: Roll out Purview DLP, labels & retention correctly on a GCC High tenant
problem: Microsoft Purview in GCC High is not the Commercial portal with a different login — admin URLs differ (compliance.microsoft.us / security.microsoft.us), and several Purview capabilities lag, are limited, or are absent versus Commercial. This is the Government edition: DLP, sensitivity labels, and retention authored for the US sovereign cloud, with the GCC High portals, endpoints, and parity gaps called out so a government tenant is configured correctly — not with Commercial steps that silently fail.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Purview information-protection model (sensitivity labels + label policies + auto-labeling, DLP across M365/endpoints, retention labels/policies and records management), and how they work together.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Microsoft 365 + Purview licensing, Entra ID, a label taxonomy, data owners, a pilot scope, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: design the label taxonomy, publish labels and label policies, configure auto-labeling, build DLP policies in audit and tune, set retention labels/policies and records, pilot, validate, then expand.
5 PowerShell scripts — Purview configuration discovery, label/DLP/retention coverage validation, a classification + DLP-event report, safe remediation of gaps, and a protection-scope group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: The Government (GCC High) edition of the Purview DLP, labels & retention solution — US-sovereign-cloud portals/endpoints and Commercial-vs-GCC-High parity gaps called out. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
